declarations.docstring: The auxiliary group-indexed polynomial factors into powers of pairwise nonassociated irreducible polynomials, with the number of factors equal to the number of conjugacy classes.
Selects a multivariate polynomial from the finite family associated to the given auxiliary datum.
Each polynomial in the finite family associated to the auxiliary datum is irreducible.
Polynomials at distinct indices in the finite family are not associated.
The total degree of a selected factor polynomial equals the corresponding auxiliary natural number.
The auxiliary group-indexed polynomial equals the product of the selected factor polynomials to their prescribed powers, scaled by the sign of inversion.
Supplies evaluation of a monoid-algebra element as its coefficient function on the group.
